decisions.reason: The division-ring clause of F3 omits axiom V1 (1 != 0) of def-division-ring and, read as a definition, incorrectly admits the zero ring. This is nonfatal for the example: F1 makes A=C a field, and the preceding field clause of F3 explicitly supplies 0 != 1. Thus step 1.1 already has both division-ring axioms. Repaired the clause by inserting the missing nontriviality axiom.

reviews.reason: Checked the full example, all direct dependency statements/definitions, the owning contract and both page interfaces. Invertibility makes the regular module simple and x -> xt identifies every simple with C. Lifting f(1) proves projectivity and the identity cover has superfluous kernel zero. Evaluation at 1 identifies Hom_C(C,C) with C over R; commutativity also identifies their rings under composition. The finite-dimensional projective-cover basis theorem applies to the unique cover. Closure under finite biproducts, kernels and cokernels gives the abelian finite-dimensional category; its set of coordinate models proves essential smallness and induction on real dimension gives finite length. The simple-class theorem then gives G0=Z[S], while K0=Z[P], with pairing entry 2, so duality fails. Single finite choices require no AC. Added only 1 != 0 to F3; the example claim, dependency interfaces, contract and page claims remain sound. This is the repair author check, not independent review of the repair.

ledger_updates.reason: F3 omitted nontriviality in its division-ring definition. Added 1 != 0, matching def-division-ring V1. The actual C example already satisfies that axiom through F1 and the field clause of F3, so its claims and calculation remain valid.
